properties.name: Whalley / Central — podium (estimated height)
properties.height_basis: Estimated 18m: report describes 5 storeys; assumed 3.6m per storey. Podium height not verified in metres.

properties.name: Fleetwood /152 Street — proposed 48-storey tower
properties.height_basis: 148m stated in City report dated 20 October 2025, PDF p. 5; 48 storeys described on pp. 1 and5. Proposed maximum height, not an approved or built measurement.
properties.footprint_basis: Approximate tower floorplate trace from PDF p. 17, level 8 plan A210 (May 23, 2024); aligned to public application boundary and street orientation.
properties.model_note: Public-plan demonstration massing, not an approved or survey-accurate 3D model. Approximate footprints traced from a published City plan and aligned to the public application boundary. Exact roof steps, facade details and terrain are omitted. Current City-approved drawings and location checks are needed for production. The report recommends referring the proposal back for refinement; this illustrates the submitted 148m scheme, not an approval. Commercial area is project-wide ground-floor space, not tower floorplate or currently available space.
properties.area_basis: City report PDF p. 5, project-wide proposed floor areas; not space available for lease.
properties.status_at_source: Initial Review / report recommends refinement

properties.name: Campbell Heights /190 Street — industrial building
properties.height_basis: 12m proposed building height in City report dated 25 September 2023, PDF pp. 5 and8. Building includes a partial mezzanine, not two complete floors.
properties.footprint_basis: Simplified trace of the actual notched building outline on PDF p. 28, site plan A-1.0, revision 7; aligned to original site boundary and190 Street / 191 Street lane.
properties.model_note: Public-plan demonstration massing, not an approved or survey-accurate 3D model. Approximate footprints traced from a published City plan and aligned to the public application boundary. Exact roof steps, facade details and terrain are omitted. Current City-approved drawings and location checks are needed for production. A single multi-tenant building with nine units. The source distinguishes industrial and commercial proposed floor areas; these are not advertised available rental space.
properties.area_basis: City report PDF p. 5; entire proposed building, industrial 6659m² plus commercial 3058m².
properties.status_at_source: Conditional Approval in public development dataset

properties.name: Bristol Estates — Tower 1 (33 storeys)

Report p. 20 gives block zoning maxima of 156/178/105 m, not individual tower heights.

Subsequent Detailed Development Permits are required for Towers 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 (report p. 24); Tower 3 has the detailed-permit package.
properties.status_at_source: Conditional Approval in public development dataset
properties.phase_basis: PDF p. 89 building-statistics table and p. 86 phasing diagram conflict for Towers 2 and 4; their phase is left unknown. Other phases agree. Sequence must be reconciled before production.
